training.effort_assignment: world-local exposure index; exposure j uses effort_cycle[j mod 4] for each world

arms.ALT_0_2: for each exposure j=0..31: update world 0 then world 2
arms.ALT_2_0: for each exposure j=0..31: update world 2 then world 0
arms.BLOCK_0_2: 32 updates of world 0, then 32 updates of world 2
arms.BLOCK_2_0: 32 updates of world 2, then 32 updates of world 0

training.primary_evaluation: after exactly 32 exposures of each world in each arm

interpretation.PARENT_P02_REPRODUCTION_MISMATCH: the exact EXP-327 ALT_0_2 P02 failure did not reproduce; no schedule-mechanism claim is allowed
interpretation.ORDER_GEOMETRY_SENSITIVE_INTERFERENCE: ALT_0_2 reproduces failure and at least one preregistered reordering arm passes; P02 interference depends on update ordering/retention geometry under the frozen court
interpretation.ORDER_GEOMETRY_INVARIANT_PAIR_FAILURE: ALT_0_2 reproduces failure and none of ALT_2_0/BLOCK_0_2/BLOCK_2_0 passes; simple schedule reordering does not rescue P02 under the frozen court

nonclaims: EXP-328 does not identify a universal catastrophic-forgetting mechanism
EXP-328 does not establish gradient conflict as the causal mechanism
EXP-328 does not establish an architectural capacity ceiling
EXP-328 does not establish that scaling would help
EXP-328 does not authorize EXP-320 or larger model sizes
